## Why this agreement exists

Freshet is published under the **AGPL-3.0**, which guarantees the code stays open. The project
also intends to be commercially sustainable — through a paid tier, distribution on channels such
as Setapp and the Mac App Store, and commercial licences for organisations that cannot use
AGPL code.

Those two things are only compatible if a single party holds the right to license the whole
codebase under more than one set of terms. That is what Section 2 provides. Without it, every
contributor would hold a veto over any future licensing decision, and the project would be
unable to ship through the channels that fund its development.

**What this means for you in practice:** you keep the copyright in your work and can reuse it
however you like. The code you contribute will always remain available under AGPL-3.0. The
Maintainer may additionally distribute it under commercial terms.

If you would rather not sign, you are still very welcome to file issues, report bugs, suggest
designs, and discuss architecture — none of that requires an agreement.
